y-m-21-05.title: Ngatigadzire kuti zvimiro zvipi zvinogona kuva regular polyhedra

y-m-21-05.material: Regular polyhedron chimiro chakasimba convex umo mativi ose ari mapolygon akaenzana anofanana uye nhamba yakafanana yemativi inosangana pavertex yose. Jiyun anoda kuziva kana angagadzira regular polyhedron nekuunganidza mativi q ari mapolygon akaenzana ane mativi p pavertex imwe neimwe. Rudaidza huwandu hwekona imwe yemukati yeregular p-gon imwe neimwe yakaunganidzwa pavertex imwe se 'huwandu hwemakona akatenderedza vertex'. Kuti vertex ive yakapinza sechimiro chakasimba, huwandu uhu hunofanira kuva pasi pe360° (kana iri 360° inova yakati sandara, uye kana iri pamusoro pe360° haigoni kupetwa). Mativi 3 kana kupfuura anosangana pavertex imwe. Kona imwe yemukati yeregular p-gon i180°×(p−2)÷p.

y-m-21-02.title: Nzira mbiri dzekuwana huwandu hwema interior angles, asi mhinduro dzakasiyana?

y-m-21-02.material: Vanhu vaviri vakawana huwandu hwema interior angles e convex pentagon (pentagon apo ma interior angles ese i mashoma kupfuura 180°) vachishandisa nzira dzakasiyana. Harin: Akadhirowa ma diagonals ese kubva pavertex imwe kuenda kune dzimwe vertices, achipatsanura pentagon kuita ma triangles 3, uye akati 180°×3=540°. Doyun: Akamaka poinzi imwe mukati mepentagon ndokuibatanidza kuma vertices ese mashanu, achiwana ma triangles 5, uye akati 180°×5=900°. I pentagon imwechete, asi mhinduro dzakasiyana. (Huwandu hwema interior angles matatu e triangle i 180°.)

Saka AB, CD, EF, GH i ma edges mana akaenzana parallel, AD, BC, EH, FG zvakare i ma edges mana akaenzana parallel, uye AE, BF, CG, DH zvakare i ma edges mana akaenzana parallel. Funga mutsetse seedge yakatambanudzwa pasina muganhu kumativi ese maviri. Seojin akati, "Kana mitsetse miviri isingasangani, i parallel."

y-m-21-01.goal: Paradzanisa kuti kukosha kwekona kwakayerwa zvakananga nemamiriro akapiwa mudambudziko zvinotsigira sei kutonga pamusoro pokufanana zvakasiyana, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kana kuvimba kwako kana ruzivo rutsva rwauya.
y-m-21-01.material: Mutsetse n unosangana nemitsetse miviri l ne m. Pamapoinzi maviri akasiyana P ne Q pa n, mutsetse n unosangana ne l ne m nenzira yakateerana, uye chinhambwe pakati pe P ne Q ndi 6cm (P iri pamusoro, Q iri pasi). Ngatiti ∠a (kona a) ive kona iri pa P iri kurudyi kumusoro kwa n, uye ∠b (kona b) ive kona iri pa Q panzvimbo imwe chete, kurudyi kumusoro kwa n. Makona maviri aya makona anoenderana. Jiho anoda kuziva kana mitsetse l ne m yakafanana. Kufanana kunoreva kuti haipindirane kunyange ukaitambanudza kure zvakadini. (Hapana mufananidzo, saka udhirowe mupfungwa kana papepa sezvakatsanangurwa pamusoro.)
y-m-21-01.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kutonga nokuvimba kwako neruzivo rutsva
y-m-21-01.prereq.0: Chirevo chemakona anoenderana nenzira yokutsvaga makona anoenderana mumufananidzo
y-m-21-01.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwokudzidza hunhu hwokuti 'kana makona anoenderana akaenzana, mitsetse miviri yakafanana'
y-m-21-01.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo rwakawanda rwunopiwa rumwe panguva imwe. Pachikamu chega chega, sarudza kutonga kwaunofunga kunowirirana nezvaunoziva ikozvino. Wobva watarisa ruzivo rwunotevera, uye ufunge kana kutonga kwako kana kuvimba kwako kunofanira kuchinja.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.hint.0: Pachikamu chega chega, nyora zvakasiyana 'kukosha kwakawanikwa nokuyera zvakananga' ne 'mamiriro akapiwa nemashoko mudambudziko'.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nemashoko ako, fungidzira zvakajeka kuti nzvimbo apo mitsetse miviri inosangana yaizova kure zvakadini kana kukosha kwawakaverenga kuri kuchisiya ne 1°.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Jiho akayera nepurotirakita uye akaverenga ∠a=65° ne ∠b=65°. Purotirakita iyi ine zviratidzo zvega zvega 1°, uye kuverenga kunogona kusiyana nenge ne 1°.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Neruzivo rwazvino, tinogona kuti mitsetse l ne m yakafanana here?
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Kuverenga kwakaenzana humbowo hwokufanana. Asi mukati mokukanganisa kwe 1°, zvakaoma kusimbirira kuti dzakaenzana chaizvo. Saka 'zvinogoneka' ne 'hazvisati zvasarudzwa' dzose dzinoenderana nekutonga parizvino.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kuverenga kwakaenzana, saka tinogona kutaura zvirokwazvo kuti yakafanana
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakatora kuverenga kwakaenzana sokureva kuti makona maviri akaenzana chaizvo. Fungawo nezvokukanganisa kunouya nokuverenga.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zvinogoneka yakafanana. Kukosha kwakafanana kwakabuda, saka parizvino ndinoiona seyakafanana
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakatora kukosha kwakafanana kwakabuda sechikonzero chokuona mukana wakakwirira.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Hadzifanani. Makona akaenzana zvakakwana haagoni kugadzirwa nepurotirakita
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: 'Zvakaoma kuverenga kukosha kwakaenzana chaizvo' ne 'makona maviri akasiyana' zvirevo zvakasiyana. Kuverenga kwakaenzana kuchiri humbowo.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Hazvisati zvasarudzwa. Kunyange kana dzasiyana nenge ne 1°, dzinogona kuverengwa nenzira iyi
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kutonga uku kwakaderedza kuvimba nokufunga kuti pane kukanganisa kwokuverenga.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Jiho akayera zvakare nepurotirakita yakanyatsonaka kwazvo uye akawana ∠a=65° ne ∠b=66°. Kana makona maviri ari 65° ne 66° chaizvo, mitsetse miviri haina kufanana, uye kana chinhambwe pakati pamapoinzi P ne Q chiri 6cm, kuverenga kwekombiyuta kunoratidza kuti inosangana panzvimbo iri inenge 2.8m kubva pamutsetse n. y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kuona ruzivo rutsva urwu, kutonga kwako kana kuvimba kwako kunofanira kuchinja sei?
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Kunyange nomusiyano we 1°, nzvimbo inosangana iri kure zvikuru kunze kwepepa, saka inoratidzika yakafanana papepa. Kuvimba kwako kungachinja kuenda kuna kuti zvakaoma kusarudza nokukosha kwakayerwa oga kana yakafanana kana kwete. Zvakadaro, kana wakachengeta kutonga kwako kwekutanga, kunofanira kuchengetwa nokungwarira se 'ingava yakafanana'.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Gumisa kuti hadzifanani, nokuti kukosha kuviri kunosiyana ne 1°
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Musiyano we 1° uri mukati mokukanganisa kwokuverenga. Zvakangoerekana kugumisa kuti hadzifanani kubva pamusiyano uyu oga.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ndichifunga kuti dzingava dzakafanana. 66° ikukoshawo kuri mukati mokukanganisa kwokuverenga
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakachengeta kutonga kwako nokufunga nezvokukanganisa. Asi nezvehuwandu hwokuvimba?
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Nzvimbo inosangana iri kure kunze kwepepa, saka zvakaoma kusarudza nokukosha kwakayerwa oga
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakaratidza mukuvimba kwako kuti nzvimbo inosangana iri kure zvokuti haigoni kunyange kuonekwa.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Kuyera nepurotirakita hakubatsiri, zvirinani kusarudza nokutarisa nameso
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Nameso, zvakaoma kwazvo kuona musiyano we 1° kupfuura nepurotirakita. Kuziva migumo yokuyera kwakasiyana nokuramba kuyera.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Mudzidzisi akakuudza mamiriro edambudziko. Dambudziko rinoti nemashoko, '∠a ne ∠b zvakaenzana.' uye haripi kukosha. Uku hakusi kukosha kwakayerwa asi mamiriro akapiwa mudambudziko.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kubva pamamiriro aya oga, tinogona kupedzisa kuti l ne m i parallel here?
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana 'corresponding angles dzakaenzana' yapiwa semamiriro, unogona kutaura nechokwadi kuti i parallel kunyange usingazivi hukuru hwema angles. Mitengo inowanikwa nekuyera ine kukanganisa, asi mamiriro akapiwa haana kukanganisa.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Hongu. Zvapiwa kuti corresponding angles dzakaenzana, saka tinogona kutaura kuti i parallel pasinei nekukanganisa
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakasiyanisa chokwadi chekuti 'akaenzana' akapiwa semamiriro i chokwadi chakasimbiswa, kwete mutengo wakayerwa.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kwete. Tisingazivi kuti ma angles ari madhigirii mangani, hatigone kusarudza kana i parallel
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kunyange chokwadi chekuti 'akaenzana' chakakwana, wakafunga kuti unogona kutonga chete kana ukaziva hukuru hwema angles.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Hongu, asi Jiho anofanira kuyera zvakare neprotractor uye atarise kuti mutengo mumwechete unobuda
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Unovimba nemutengo wakayerwa zvakananga kupfuura mamiriro akapiwa. Kana mutengo wakayerwa usingabvumirani, ungafungawo kuti chimiro hachina kunaka.
y-m-21-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Kwete. Jiho anofanira kuyera zvakare neprotractor uye mitengo miviri inofanira kuenzana

y-m-21-03.topic: Central angles, arcs, ne chords ye sector
y-m-21-03.goal: Wana mutsetse wakaipa mumhinduro yakashandisa property yekuti arc length i directly proportional ne central angle kuma chords zvakare, uye usimbise kuti chord length haisi directly proportional uchishandisa zviitiko zvema central angles 180° ne 120°.
y-m-21-03.material: Pane denderedzwa O rine radius ye 6cm. Pamapoinzi A, B, C pamudenderedzwa, ∠AOB=60° ne ∠AOC=180°. Chord i mutsetse unobatanidza mapoinzi maviri pamudenderedzwa. Seoyun akagadzirisa seanotevera kuwana kureba kwe chord AC. Zvakatozivikanwa: Mu sector, arc length i directly proportional nehukuru hwe central angle. (Triangle OAB i equilateral triangle ine mativi ese matatu 6cm, saka chord AB=6cm.)

y-m-21-03.s.s1.line.0: Triangle OAB ine OA=OB=6cm ne ∠AOB=60°, saka i equilateral triangle, uye chord AB=6cm.
y-m-21-03.s.s1.line.2: Hukuru hwe central angle ne arc length zvakananga proportional, saka chord length i directly proportional ne central angle zvakare.
y-m-21-03.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 wakaipa. Arc length i directly proportional nehukuru hwe central angle, asi chord length haisi. 18cm yemutsetse 4 i mutengo wakabva pamutsetse 3 wakaipa (kana wakasarudza mutsetse 4, wakawana kuti mhedzisiro i isiri iyo, asi chikonzero i mutsetse 3).
y-m-21-03.s.s2.prompt: Nzira iri nyore zvikuru yekusimbisa kuti mhedzisiro yaSeoyun ye 18cm i isiri iyo i ipi? (Funga chord AC ne ∠AOC=180°.)
y-m-21-03.s.s2.hint.0: Dhirowa kuti mapoinzi matatu A, O, C akarongwa sei kana ∠AOC=180°.
y-m-21-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ipapo taura kureba kwe AC zvakananga uchishandisa radius uye uienzanise nemutengo waSeoyun.
y-m-21-03.s.s2.o.a: Circumference yedenderedzwa i 12π cm (anenge 37.7cm), saka 18cm i pfupi kupfuura circumference uye i mutengo unogoneka
y-m-21-03.s.s2.r.a: Wakaenzanisa chord length ne circumference yedenderedzwa. Funga kana iri kureba kwakakodzera kuenzanisa chord nako.

y-m-21-03.s.s2.r.b: Wakangotarisa zvakare kuverenga nepfungwa imwechete yeproportion. Edza pfungwa yeproportion pachayo.
y-m-21-03.s.s2.o.c: Kana ∠AOC=180°, AC i diameter inopfuura nepakati pedenderedzwa uye i 12cm, saka 18cm i hombe kupfuura iyoyo uye hazvigoneke

y-m-21-03.s.s2.o.d: Chord i pfupi kupfuura arc yayo, saka kuenzanisa nekureba kwe arc AC, 6π (anenge 18.8cm), 18cm i mutengo unogoneka uye Seoyun akarurama
y-m-21-03.s.s2.r.d: Zvakarurama kuti chord i pfupi kupfuura arc yayo. Asi kuenzanisa uku oga hakuratidzi kuti 18cm i isiri iyo.

y-m-21-03.s.s3.model.1: Ndinofunga i pfupi. Pa central angle 60° i 6cm uye pa 180° i 12cm, uye 120° i pakati pavo, saka inofanira kuva shoma kupfuura 12cm. Kana central angle ikava ka3 yakakura (kubva pa 60° kusvika ku 180°), chord inova ka2 yakareba chete, saka hazvisi direct proportion.

y-m-21-06.title: Makani ane volume yakafanana: dhizaini ipi inoshandisa sheet metal shoma zvikuru?
y-m-21-06.goal: Gadzira dhizaini dzakawanda iwe amene uye uzvienzanise kuratidza kuti surface area inogona kusiyana kunyange volume yakafanana, sarudza dhizaini inoshandisa zvishoma zvikuru nehuwandu hwesurface area, uye utaurewo chimwe chinhu chekufunga kunze kwesurface area.
y-m-21-06.material: Unoda kugadzira kani rezvokudya rine chimiro checylinder. Volume yekani yakagadzikwa pa36π cm³ (volume yecylinder i π×(radius yebase)×(radius yebase)×(hurefu)). Zvivharo zvepamusoro nepazasi nedivi zvose isheet metal, uye surface area i2π×r×r+2π×r×h (r iradius yebase, h ihurefu, mucm). Rega kufunga nezvehukora hwesheet metal nemubatanidzwa. Sheet metal inoshandiswa shoma, mutengo unodzika, asi zvinokosha zvakare kana vanhu vachiona zvichiita nyore kushandisa. Radius nehurefu zvose zvinosarudzwa senhamba dzechisikigo.
y-m-21-06.prereq.0: Maitiro ekuwana volume nesurface area yecylinder (maformula ari muzvinhu)
y-m-21-06.s.s1.prompt: Gadzira dhizaini dzakasiyana dzisingadzikiri pa3 dzekani rine chimiro checylinder rine volume ye36π cm³. Radius yebase r (cm) nehurefu h (cm) inhamba dzechisikigo.
y-m-21-06.s.s1.hint.0: Muformula yevolume π×r×r×h, siya π uwane nyaya umo r×r×h i36.
y-m-21-06.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza r uchitanga pa1 uye uongorore kana h ichibuda senhamba yechisikigo.
y-m-21-06.s.s1.fail.c1: r ne h zvinofanira kuva nhamba dzechisikigo dziri 1 kana kupfuura.
y-m-21-06.s.s1.fail.c2: Volume (π×r×r×h) haisi 36π. Ongorora kana r×r×h i36.
y-m-21-06.s.s1.explain: Nhamba dzechisikigo dzinoita r×r×h=36 ina chete: (r, h)=(1, 36), (2, 9), (3, 4), (6, 1). h inhamba yechisikigo chete kana r×r iri divisor ye36.
y-m-21-06.s.s2.prompt: Wana surface area yedhizaini imwe neimwe yedhizaini ina (surface area=2π×r×r+2π×r×h). Surface area inochinja sei sezvo r ichikura kuburikidza ne1, 2, 3, 6?
y-m-21-06.s.s2.hint.0: Pamadhizaini ose ana, verenga 2×r×r ne2×r×h wega uzvinyore mutebhura.
y-m-21-06.s.s2.hint.1: Mutebhura, enzanisa kuti zvikamu zviviri zvimwe nezvimwe zvinofamba sei sezvo r ichikura nezvinoitika kuhuwandu.
y-m-21-06.s.s2.o.a: Zvichienda zvichikura r, surface area inoramba ichidzika chete
y-m-21-06.s.s2.r.a: Kana r ichikura, divi rinova diki asi zvivharo zvinova zvikuru. Fungidzira kana wakaverengawo surface area ya r=6, h=1.
y-m-21-06.s.s2.o.b: Sezvo r ichikura, surface area inoramba ichikwira chete
y-m-21-06.s.s2.r.b: r=1, h=36 ikani refu rakanyanya kuonda. Fungidzira kana wakaverenga surface area yekani iri.
y-m-21-06.s.s2.o.c: Mavolume akafanana, saka masurface area emadhizaini ana ndiwo akafananawo
y-m-21-06.s.s2.r.c: Kuva nevolume yakafanana nekuva nesurface area yakafanana zvinhu zvakasiyana. Verenga uye uenzanise masurface area emadhizaini maviri iwe amene.
y-m-21-06.s.s2.o.d: Inodzika, wobva yakwira zvakare mushure me r=3
y-m-21-06.s.s2.r.d: Wakaongorora mutebhura kuti nzvimbo yedivi neyechivharo zvinofamba nenzira dzakapesana.
